description: Who a message to a session is from, as its host's sender store keeps it (by the message's uuid): a Sender, and what heads show of the message in place of its text, if the host says (shown).

session.description: Its session's id, on its host.

bot.description: A chat a task's run started (a subagent sender, its report of a turn): the session of the run's Bot, on its host.

task.description: A task's run's: the id of its task, on its Bot's Tasks page.

task_name.description: A chat a task's run started: its task's name, as the from line says it ("<task> run").

run.description: A task's run's: the id of the run, on its Bot's Tasks page (its Bot: bot, else its session).

over.description: A chat a task's run started: how the turn it reports ended (finished; stopped: interrupted or stopped; failed: an error, or its agent ended before its turn did).

shown.description: What heads show of the message in place of its text: set by the host only (a held answer sent: its shown, its agent having been told more).
